headline: The Opening Lines Are In
dek: The EFL still has no completed 2026 fantasy week, but fresh Sleeper projections have sharpened the Week 1 slate with two near-tossups, two heavy early favorites and a power board waiting for real results.

lead.title: Sleeper's First Full Week 1 Read Turns the Spotlight From Rankings to Matchups
lead.body: The 2026 EFL season is still in preview mode as of September 1: no fantasy matchup has been completed, so there are no legitimate scoring trends, winners or losers to manufacture. What the league does have now is a fresh Sleeper-based Week 1 projection set across all six matchups. The September 1 model shows a slate with real contrast — two games separated by less than five projected points, including one matchup split just 51.2% to 48.8%, while two other pairings carry favorite probabilities of 82.4% and 76.8%. The published EFL power board remains the August 25 order, with Master Peyton No. 1 at 89.2, The Don's Soldiers No. 2 at 84.2, Kaaron Rodgers No. 3 at 83.8 and defending champion Blaze Infantry No. 4 at 75.3. Until actual Week 1 scores arrive, projections are context rather than proof — but the opening slate is finally taking shape.

briefs.label: MATCHUP WATCH
briefs.title: Two Week 1 Games Open Almost Dead Even
briefs.body: The latest Sleeper projection model identifies two especially tight Week 1 matchups. The closest is separated by only 1.19 projected points and carries a 51.2%-48.8% win-probability split. Another is separated by 4.38 projected points with a 53.8%-46.2% split. Before any real scoring begins, those are the two clearest candidates for opening-week drama.

briefs.label: FAVORITE WATCH
briefs.title: The Early Model Also Shows Two Clear Favorites
briefs.body: Not every Week 1 pairing looks close on paper. One matchup currently carries an 82.4% projected win chance for the favorite, while another sits at 76.8%. The highest individual team projection on the six-game slate is 147.91 points. Those numbers establish the early expectation, but no EFL franchise has earned anything yet — the first actual scores will decide whether the model was signal or noise.

briefs.label: POWER BOARD
briefs.title: Master Peyton Still Owns the Published No. 1 Spot
briefs.body: The most recent published EFL power rankings remain the August 25 edition. Master Peyton leads at 89.2, followed by The Don's Soldiers at 84.2 and Kaaron Rodgers at 83.8, with Blaze Infantry fourth at 75.3. The Don's Soldiers and Kaaron Rodgers are separated by only 0.4 Power Score points, leaving the first completed fantasy week positioned to provide the first meaningful on-field evidence in that contender race.

briefs.label: WEEK 1 CLOCK
briefs.title: The League Is Still Waiting for the First Real Box Scores
briefs.body: The NFL regular season has not started yet, so the EFL correctly remains on Week 1 under its preseason convention. That means there are no completed fantasy results or scoring trends to report in this edition. The newsroom is treating projections as projections and is not presenting unverified trades, waivers or free-agent activity as fact; once completed Sleeper data exists, the weekly report can shift from preview mode to results, movement and transaction analysis.
